# Feature: Setup detect UI

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #22 -->

## Intent
J-001 in the browser: candidates with evidence, ambiguity side-by-side, manual correction, doctor. DetectionCard uses radio semantics. Potato Boost must not claim a unique auto-pick (SCN-002). Confirm writes config; cancel writes nothing.

## Preconditions
- Dashboard shell exists (#21)
- `potato init --confirm` writer exists (#13)
- Web doctor exists (#14)
- Local API loopback + token exists (#20)

## Happy Path
- [x] DetectionCard shows evidence and confidence (0–1, not a fake 96%); start argv can be overridden
- [x] Doctor errors are concrete capability messages (id, path, detail)
- [x] Cancel / preview writes no config (API test: 0 files); confirm writes once via `applyInit`
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [x] Ambiguous: two or more supported candidates → two cards, none auto-selected, no unique-detection claim
- [x] Unknown / empty repo → unsupported card, confidence 0, override still possible
- [x] Confirm stays explicit (no write on detect or doctor GET/POST)
- [x] Dashboard Origin on another loopback port can call the API; foreign Origin stays 403

## Regression
- [ ] Run token still not in localStorage/sessionStorage
- [ ] Existing local-api token/origin/SSE tests still pass
- [ ] `potato init` without `--confirm` still writes nothing
- [ ] Scope: `apps/dashboard/**`, `packages/local-api/**`, small reuse in core preview + web doctor start override — no scenario recorder, no Compare

## Assumptions
- Project root is bound when the local API starts (`projectRoot`); clients cannot pass a filesystem path
- Start command is an argv array (whitespace-split in the UI, not a shell string)
- FR-006 in this slice is a post-confirm recommendation line (adapter id + next: doctor), not a full template catalog
- UI copy is English

## Security Coverage
- F-01: waived (loopback-only)
- F-02: adapterId/start validated with Zod; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`
- F-03: token stays in module memory; source does not call localStorage/sessionStorage
- F-04 analog: mutating routes still require Bearer token; CORS is loopback-origin only (not `*`)
- F-05: no API keys in the client bundle
- B-03: detect/doctor/config require the run token
- B-04: argv arrays only; doctor does not execute start
- B-08: unknown routes remain Fastify 404; no client-supplied role
- B-09: identity is the process token, not a client header role
- P-02: error envelopes do not include the token or stack
- P-04: writes stay inside `assertInsideRoot(projectRoot, …)`; no client `root` field
- Potato-Boost: detect is read-only; writes only on `POST /api/v1/config/confirm`

## Implementation Notes
- `apps/dashboard`: DetectionCard radios, `/setup/detect` confirm/cancel/preview, `/setup/doctor` capability table. Confidence is a 0–1 fraction (never 96%).
- `packages/local-api`: `GET /api/v1/detect`, `POST /api/v1/config/{preview,cancel,confirm}`, `POST /api/v1/doctor`. Project root bound at start. Loopback CORS (not `*`).
- `buildInitPreview` / `runWebDoctor` accept start argv overrides. Writes only via `applyInit(true)`.
- Browser proof: `.qa/evidence/setup-detect-ui/01-detect-ambiguous.png`, `02-doctor-capability.png`.
- `pnpm checks` 111 tests; typed-strict clean on touched TS.
